sentences.text: Shri Ashish Tiwari - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri Akhilendra Singh - Government Advocate for the res
Heard on admission.
Admit.

Also heard on IA No.12074/2023, which is first application filed under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of appellants namely Manohar and Vinod.

Appellants stand convicted vide judgment dated 28.04.2023 passed by First ASJ, Niwari District Tikamgarh M.P. in ST No.59/2018 for offence under Section 366, 370, 376(2)(n) and 376(Gha) of IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 05 years & fine Rs.1000/-; RI for 07 years & fine Rs.1000/-, RI for 20 years & fine Rs.1000/- and RI for 20 years & fine Rs.1000/- each for respective offences with default stipulation.
As per the case of the prosecution, allegation against the appellants is that they abducted the prosecutrix, committed rape with her several times and also tried to sell her.
On the basis of the aforesaid, offence as mentioned above has been registered against the accused persons.
It submitted by the counsel for the appellants that the appellants are innocent and have falsely been implicated in the case.
They have not committed any offence as alleged.
It is also submitted that DNA is found negative and as per MLC no internal or external injury has been found on the person of the 2 CRA-6875-2023 prosecutrix.
There is no other evidence to support the case of the prosecution.
Since the appeal is of the year 2023, final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future and the appellants have incarcerated in jail about 03 years
, therefore, it is prayed that the remaining jail sentence may be suspended and appellants may be released on bail.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State supported the impugned judgment and prays for rejection of application for suspension of sentence.
We have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

Having considered the rival submissions coupled with the fact that DNA is negative and MLC indicates no internal or external injury on the person of the prosecutrix; the appellants are in jail for about 03 years and final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future, therefore, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, IA No.12074/2023 is allowed.

It is directed that subject to depositing the entire fine amount, if already not deposited, the substantive jail sentence of appellants shall remain suspended till the final disposal of the appeal and they be released on bail, on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- each with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court, for their appearance before the concerned trial Court firstly on 05.02.2025, and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the said Court in this regard.
List for final hearing in due course alongwith connected case.
